## History

Twenty-five years ago, Irving proposed to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) under a honeysuckle trellis, but their initial engagement was eventually broken off. Years later, after his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) was introduced to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), the couple reunited and were married in the [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) garden. In time, Irving visited [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside his wife for a summer stay.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P6](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0006), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), +123 more_

## Relationships

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--irving.md)

Irving and [Dora](../character/dora.md) are childhood acquaintances who are friends. Their connection persists through family visits and gatherings during school breaks, such as when [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday.

- Friend of — childhood acquaintance  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is Irving's wife, following a long period of courtship and a previously broken engagement. After reconnecting through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Irving's son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), the two were married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together from the station. They continue to live as a married couple, visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and maintaining close ties with [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Romantically involved with — taking a walk together while courting  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — fiancé/husband  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Irving's young son. After being introduced to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) shared in the excitement surrounding his father's wedding preparations. As [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) grows older, Irving continues to spend time with him during family visits to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Parent of — father  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>
